temperature_tolerance.frost_tolerance: Can handle temps down to 28°F; frost improves flavor

austin_spring.notes: Plant in partial shade once temps exceed 85°F; provide shade cloth if needed

austin_fall.notes: Best planting window for Austin; thrives in cool weather

yield_info.yield_per_plant: 1-2 lbs over season with cut-and-come-again harvesting

description: Nutrient-dense leafy green that thrives in cool weather (50-75°F). Very frost tolerant down to 28°F - frost actually improves flavor. Less heat-tolerant than mustard greens; may bolt in Austin summer heat. Provide shade when temps exceed 85°F. Continuous harvest through cut-and-come-again method. One of the healthiest vegetables with high vitamins A, C, K. Best grown fall through spring in Central Texas.
